Summary: Cart item not removed when quantity decreased to 0
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Add item to cart 2. Click '-' until quantity reaches 0
Expected Result: Item should be automatically removed from cart
Actual Result: Item remains in cart displayed with quantity 0

Summary: Search results differ when query has leading/trailing spaces
Expected Result: Both searches should return identical results

Summary: No account lockout after repeated failed login attempts
Expected Result: Account should temporarily lock and show warning
Actual Result: User can attempt unlimited login tries

Summary: Cart/checkout data lost on browser back navigation
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Fill checkout form 2. Click browser back 3. Return to checkout
Actual Result: Form resets, cart items sometimes cleared

Summary: Duplicate cart line created instead of incrementing quantity (intermittent)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Add same item to cart twice quickly (double-click)
Expected Result: Quantity should increment on existing line
